mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_trace ( trace_id, user_id, username, user_message, status, total_cost_ms, tool_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{userMessage}, #{status}, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )

INSERT INTO agent_trace_step ( trace_id, step_type, step_name, input_data, output_data, status, error_message, cost_ms, sort_order, create_time ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{stepType}, #{stepName}, #{inputData}, #{outputData}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{costMs}, #{sortOrder}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_trace SET final_reply = #{finalReply}, status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, total_cost_ms = #{totalCostMs}, tool_count = #{toolCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, trace_id, user_id, username, user_message, final_reply, status, error_message, total_cost_ms, tool_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM agent_trace WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, trace_id, step_type, step_name, input_data, output_data, status, error_message, cost_ms, sort_order, create_time FROM agent_trace_step WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_trace_step WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND step_type = 'TOOL_CALL'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount,
CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1), 2) END AS successRate,
ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(total_cost_ms), 0), 2) AS avgCostMs,
IFNULL(MAX(total_cost_ms), 0) AS maxCostMs,
ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(tool_count), 0), 2) AS avgToolCount FROM agent_trace WHERE is_deleted = 0
